gists.gist: The Court impleaded all State Governments and Union Territories (through their Municipal Administration and Urban Development Departments) and the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways as party-respondents, holding their presence necessary to implement the ministries' directions of 21 and 23 August 2026, and ordered notices to issue.
gists.latest_development: On 24 August 2026, the Supreme Court impleaded all States, UTs and the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways as respondents and directed notices for implementation of the recent ministry directions on footpaths.
